description: Runner receipt signer trust. The trusted public key identifies the out-of-tree, root-owned mode-0600 signer on the disposable runner VM; the private key is never printed, copied into Git, or readable by runner identities. The unprivileged endpoint never signs, and the root-owned signer rebuilds and signs only manifests whose fields prove a clean pass after exact archive/tree/environment/verifier/probes passed. Signer rotation is fail-closed: a manifest signed by a key that is no longer in public_keys, or claiming a foreign principal/namespace, is rejected.
